name: Adspirer Social Ads
description: Paid social agent for Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram) and TikTok Ads. Research competitor ads, review performance, catch creative fatigue and wasted spend, and plan, create and optimize campaigns, ad sets and ads, with your approval before any change that affects spend.
accessRequirements: An Adspirer account, an applicable Adspirer plan, and authorized access to at least one Meta ad account (with a Facebook Page for ads that need one) or TikTok Ads advertiser account. Capabilities depend on platform permissions, eligibility, plan limits and the platforms' API limits. Advertising spend is billed separately by Meta and TikTok. Muse connector availability is subject to review and enablement.
examplePrompts: Show how my Meta and TikTok accounts have done over the last 90 days: each campaign with its status, impressions, clicks, spend and conversions. If there's no recent data, use the latest period that has data and tell me which dates the numbers cover.
Find wasted spend and creative fatigue across my Meta and TikTok ads over the last 90 days. Rank what to fix first, but don't change anything.
Help me research audiences: find Meta interest targeting for "premium watches" with audience sizes, and TikTok interest keywords for "fitness".

Create a paused Meta image campaign for my online watch store at $40 a day, targeting US watch and luxury shoppers, with a headline and primary text you write. Keep it paused, and tell me what you'd change to raise the budget to $50 without making that change.
Show me the ads my biggest competitor is running on Meta and TikTok right now, then suggest three ad concepts that would stand out against them.
